study: Study label: first author and year (suffix a/b for separate trials reported under one SLEEPI label)
condition_arm1: Psychological treatment in arm 1 (cbt = cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia, bt = behavioural therapy, ct = cognitive or third-wave therapy, re = relaxation)
condition_arm2: Control condition in arm 2 (wl = waitlist, nt = no treatment, plb = placebo or attention control, pe = psychoeducation or sleep hygiene education, ctr = unspecified control)
multi_arm1: Original arm label of arm 1; only filled for trials with more than two arms
multi_arm2: Original arm label of arm 2; only filled for trials with more than two arms
.g: Hedges' g calculated with metapsyTools; positive values favour arm 1 for all outcomes
outcome_type: Type of effect size data (msd = endpoint means and SDs, change = change scores, used only if endpoint data are missing, remission = number of remitters)
instrument: Measurement instrument (insomnia severity scale, e.g. isi, psqi; se = sleep efficiency, tst = total sleep time, sol = sleep onset latency, waso = wake after sleep onset; for remission, the scale used to define remission, nr = not reported)
rating: Rating of the outcome (self-report for all outcomes; sleep parameters are taken from sleep diaries, not polysomnography or actigraphy)
n_arm1: Sample size for the endpoint mean in arm 1
n_arm2: Sample size for the endpoint mean in arm 2
mean_change_arm1: Mean change from baseline in arm 1
sd_change_arm1: Standard deviation of the change from baseline in arm 1
n_change_arm1: Sample size for the change score in arm 1
mean_change_arm2: Mean change from baseline in arm 2
sd_change_arm2: Standard deviation of the change from baseline in arm 2
n_change_arm2: Sample size for the change score in arm 2
dich_paper: Definition of remission as reported in the paper
totaln_arm1: Denominator for remission in arm 1 (number randomized, intention-to-treat)
totaln_arm2: Denominator for remission in arm 2 (number randomized, intention-to-treat)
precalc_g: Pre-calculated Hedges' g (not extracted; always NA)
precalc_g_se: Standard error of the pre-calculated Hedges' g (not extracted; always NA)
precalc_log_rr: Pre-calculated log risk ratio (not extracted; always NA)
precalc_log_rr_se: Standard error of the pre-calculated log risk ratio (not extracted; always NA)
baseline_m_arm1: Baseline mean of insomnia severity in arm 1 (insomnia severity rows only)
baseline_sd_arm1: Baseline standard deviation of insomnia severity in arm 1
baseline_m_arm2: Baseline mean of insomnia severity in arm 2 (insomnia severity rows only)
baseline_sd_arm2: Baseline standard deviation of insomnia severity in arm 2
rand_arm1: Number of participants randomized to arm 1
rand_arm2: Number of participants randomized to arm 2
year: Publication year of the primary reference
time_weeks: Time point in weeks (post: duration of treatment; fu: long-term follow-up time point, longest follow-up between 3 and 12 months)
time: Assessment point (post = end of treatment, fu = long-term follow-up)
outcome_domain: Outcome domain (insomnia_severity, sleep_efficiency, total_sleep_time, sleep_onset_latency, waso, remission)
higher_better: TRUE if higher values indicate improvement (sleep efficiency, total sleep time); used to align the direction of .g
format: Delivery format of the treatment in arm 1 (ind = individual face-to-face, grp = group face-to-face, mixed = individual and group face-to-face, remote = internet, app, telephone or self-help)
format_details: SLEEPI treatment component codes of arm 1
components_arm2: SLEEPI treatment component codes of arm 2
country: Country in which the trial was conducted
recruitment: Recruitment (single = single site, multi = multiple sites)
diagnosis: Insomnia diagnosis required for inclusion (formal_* = diagnostic criteria, e.g. formal_DSM; informal_* = cut-off on a self-report scale, e.g. informal_ISI; others)
comorbidity: Eligible comorbidities (primary_insomnia, primary_secondary_mixed, psy_* = mental disorders, phy_* = physical conditions, psy_phy_mixed)
icc: Intra-cluster correlation coefficient for cluster-randomized trials
mean_age: Mean age of the study sample (weighted across arms)
percent_women: Proportion of women in the study sample (0-1)
rob_d1: RoB 2, domain 1: bias arising from the randomization process (low, some concerns, high)
rob_d2: RoB 2, domain 2: bias due to deviations from intended interventions (low, some concerns, high)
rob_d3: RoB 2, domain 3: bias due to missing outcome data (low, some concerns, high)
rob_d4: RoB 2, domain 4: bias in measurement of the outcome (low, some concerns, high)
rob_d5: RoB 2, domain 5: bias in selection of the reported result (low, some concerns, high)
rob: RoB 2 overall judgement (low, some concerns, high)
.log_rr: Log risk ratio calculated with metapsyTools (remission rows)
.event_arm1: Number of events in arm 1 used by metapsyTools
.event_arm2: Number of events in arm 2 used by metapsyTools
.totaln_arm1: Total sample size in arm 1 used by metapsyTools
.totaln_arm2: Total sample size in arm 2 used by metapsyTools
full_ref: Full reference of the primary publication
pmid: PubMed ID of the primary publication
